Title: Maa Inti Bangaaram
Writer: Prahaas Boppudi, Vasanth Maringanti, Raj Nidimoru
Actors: Samantha Ruth Prabhu, Gulshan Devaiah, Gautami
Plot: Through both her moments of fear and bravery, a woman discovers that embracing her vulnerabilities is as vital to her inner strength as facing challenges head-on.
